_note: Standard camera views for the MapLibre viewer, passed to __viewer.flyTo(). MapLibre keys: center [lon,lat], zoom, pitch (0-85, degrees down from vertical), bearing. These replaced Cesium's lon/lat/height/heading/pitch, which MapLibre silently ignored - every view resolved to zoom 14.8 pitch 0, so they all framed the same thing. Verified to render as described; update in the same commit as any viewer change.
